resources.string: Read car hotspot info
Enable car hotspot
Enable the car hotspot?

If the hotspot is off, enabling it may turn off the car’s current Wi-Fi client connection and disconnect services using that connection. DiPlay will keep the existing hotspot configuration and will not turn Wi-Fi off itself. Continue?
Enable hotspot
This firmware has no verified setting for choosing a 5 GHz hotspot band. DiPlay will not change the band.
Wi-Fi Direct mode is unavailable on this Android version. Use the car’s built-in hotspot mode.
Read the current car hotspot settings, or enable it after reviewing the Wi-Fi warning.
Car hotspot status: %1$s
A hotspot operation is still pending. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
The operation is still pending. Its result is unknown; check the car hotspot status before trying again.
Read car hotspot: SSID “%1$s”; security %2$s; band %3$s; channel %4$s. Password is saved in the masked field.

The car hotspot is already enabled. DiPlay left it running without restarting it.
The car reported that its hotspot is enabled.
Could not read the current hotspot configuration. Nothing was changed.
The hotspot security or password could not be read in a supported form. Nothing was changed.
Android denied access to the hotspot service. Nothing was changed.
Could not read the hotspot state. Nothing was changed.
The hotspot is already changing state. Wait for the car to finish before trying again.
The car reported a hotspot start failure.
The car rejected the hotspot start request.
The car did not report an enabled hotspot before the timeout. Check its state before trying again.
The operation was canceled before a start request could be confirmed.
The hotspot operation failed. Nothing was changed unless the car accepted a start request; check its state before retrying.
